products.label: JPL Horizons, satellite ephemerides NEP098 and NEP104
products.process: Take every confirmed moon of Neptune in the pinned JPL catalogue that has no object package and has a Horizons code; ask Horizons for its geometric position relative to Neptune's centre at the world's epoch; draw one dot at that position.
limitations: No color is measured for these moons; every dot is the neutral gray the app gives a moon without a measured color, and its size is a display choice.
